articles.title: Trump staffer Britt McHenry escorted from NBA arena after throwing beer at fan
articles.summary: The Washington Wizards opened their much-anticipated NBA season with a win, but Trump staffer Britt McHenry didn’t see it all. McHenry was in attendance for...
articles.body:
The Washington Wizards opened their much-anticipated NBA season with a win, but Trump staffer Britt McHenry didn't see it all.

McHenry was in attendance for the start of the game between the Wizards and Milwaukee Bucks Wednesday night, but the former Fox News and ESPN host was forced to leave Capital One Arena in Washington, D.C., early after a heated incident with fans.

According to Page Six , McHenry and a friend were sitting in front of a group of fans who became loud and obnoxious. After they allegedly began heckling former Wizard and current Bucks forward Kyle Kuzma, McHenry supposedly asked the fans to "ease up," which prompted them to redirect their attention toward her.

A source told Page Six that one of the fans escalated the situation by saying misogynistic things to McHenry before throwing a drink at the current Trump administration press adviser. McHenry retaliated by doing the same thing. Security later arrived to escort McHenry from the stands, allegedly removing the fan who threw a drink at her as well.

The video shows McHenry had a drink thrown at her while leaving the seat, which led the former Fox News host to grab a beverage and toss it back at the fan, spawning a sort of food fight with several items being sent in her direction. But according to one witness who shared the above video, McHenry also threw a burger at a fan before people began recording the incident.

Page Six claims McHenry was escorted out of the arena. Although the video shows her walking out of the arena with security, TMZ reported McHenry wasn't kicked out, alleging she opted to leave while her friend went back to their seats.

ESPN infamously suspended McHenry for one week after she was caught on video berating a tow company employee. She has since claimed the tow truck company's publicly released video was " highly edited" and "highly doctored. "

McHenry has not yet commented on the videos.

articles.title: 'Yet more rest needed': Amitabh Bachchan shares health update after social media break
articles.summary: Veteran actor Amitabh Bachchan shared a fresh update on his health, saying he needs more rest as he continues to recover.
articles.body: Veteran actor Amitabh Bachchan shared a fresh update on his health, saying he needs more rest as he continues to recover. The actor posted the message on his Tumblr blog on Friday, a day after announcing a temporary break from online communication following medical advice.Amitabh Bachchan regularly interacts with fans through his blog and social media accounts. "Yet more rest needed .. adjusting .. thinking and wondering .. the human body and its uniqueness," he wrote.Amitabh Bachchan says he is following doctors' adviceThe actor's latest post follows an earlier message in which he apologised to fans for being unable to share regular updates. Amitabh Bachchan explained that doctors instructed him to avoid writing and communicating online for a few days. He is currently following their advice and prioritising rest.Before his latest Tumblr update, Amitabh Bachchan addressed fans on X while extending his Dussehra greetings. He also explained that his doctors placed him under strict instructions to rest and recuperate."First Dussehra greetings to all .. love happiness, fulfilment, prayers. Under very strict rest and recuperation .. so am not allowed to communicate .. do excuse .. my apologies," he wrote.The actor further asked his followers to treat the message as his response for the time being. He expressed hope that he would be able to communicate more regularly later. "But do take this as my respected response .. more hopefully later."Mumbai police investigate reported bomb threat emailThe health update comes amid reports of a bomb threat email allegedly targeting Amitabh Bachchan's bungalow in Mumbai. According to reports, a school in the city's Bandra-Kurla Complex (BKC) area received the email on Friday.Mumbai Police have launched an investigation into the reported threat. However, it has not been confirmed whether the email specifically named either Jalsa or Prateeksha, the actor's residences in Mumbai. The available information does not establish any connection between the reported threat and Amitabh Bachchan's health update. The police investigation into the email remains ongoing.Amitabh Bachchan's longstanding connection with fansAmitabh Bachchan has used digital platforms for years to share personal reflections and communicate with his audience. He started his personal blog in 2008 and has continued to post updates about his experiences, thoughts and professional activities.Amitabh Bachchan's most recent major film release, according to the information available, was the Tamil-Hindi bilingual action drama 'Vettaiyan'. The film was released in theatres on October 10, 2024. Up next, Big B will be seen in 'Kalki 2'.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: ‘What’s with the hate?’: Kriti Sanon reacts to backlash over her Raksha Bandhan ad outfit on Kareena Kapoor's talk show
articles.summary: Kriti Sanon faced heavy trolling on social media in August over her outfit in a Raksha Bandhan ad, with critics calling it “revealing”.
articles.body: Kriti Sanon faced heavy trolling on social media in August over her outfit in a Raksha Bandhan ad, with critics calling it “revealing”. The brand eventually pulled the ad. Speaking to Kareena Kapoor Khan on 'What Women Want', Kriti has now addressed the backlash. She said she generally doesn’t pay attention to trolls, but added, “But this is something that actually happened recently where my choli became the national debate. I couldn’t believe that my choli had become a six-people panel discussion on prime-time news. I was like, ‘What is going on?’”.Kriti Sanon on her choli becoming a ‘national debate’The actress said she was shocked by the intensity of the hate, but felt the issue went beyond her. “I felt that it was not about me; it was a much larger issue, where I felt like women are under scrutiny for everything, and it is only women who get targeted for the smallest thing,” she said, adding, “The amount of hate that happens. What’s with the hate?” Though she usually ignores trolls, Kriti spoke about how nasty people can get. “People who were talking about culture and respect were ironically the ones who were commenting on my parents’ posts and sister’s posts with the nastiest abusive language. They read all these things. What have they done?”.Kriti Sanon on what women actually want“It is important for women to stand up for themselves because I feel like everything is such a question, and who has given this right to these people to be commenting on us, and for what? What women actually want is to not be judged and for people to actually mind their own business," Kriti concluded.Kriti Sanon’s Raksha Bandhan ad rowThe row began when GIVA released its Raksha Bandhan ad starring Kriti Sanon, in which she wears an Indo-Western outfit and ties a rakhi to her brother and her pet dog. Kriti had earlier responded to the backlash on Instagram, questioning why women are still judged by what they wear. “Also, when will we stop telling women what to wear? Ethnic fashion has evolved over the years, yet a woman’s respect for her culture is still measured by her clothes. Culture and traditions are in her heart, not in her neckline!”.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. Download the TOI app.Give your child the gift of confidence! articles.title: Tiger Shroff sells Mumbai apartment for Rs 9 crore days after firing incident near his car in Juhu, third property sale by the actor in about a year
articles.summary: Tiger Shroff has sold an apartment in Mumbai’s Khar West for Rs 9 crore.
articles.body: Tiger Shroff has sold an apartment in Mumbai’s Khar West for Rs 9 crore. As per property registration documents, the deal was registered on October 22, 2026. This is the third property sale by the actor in about a year. Let's learn more about it in detail.Details of the Khar West apartmentAccording to documents shared by real estate data analytics firm CRE Matrix, the flat is on the ninth floor of Rustomjee Paramount D Co-operative Housing Society. It has a carpet area of 1,291.14 sq ft and an exclusive area of 95.80 sq ft. The sale was done at around Rs 64,891 per sq ft. A stamp duty of Rs 54 lakh was paid, and the deal includes two covered car parking spaces.The documents show that Tiger had bought the flat from developer Keystone Realtors Private Limited on July 17, 2018, for Rs 7.61 crore. He took possession on November 30, 2019. The actor could not be reached for comment.The sale comes soon after Tiger made headlines for a scary incident. On the evening of October 18, at least two men opened fire at his car in Mumbai’s Juhu area and then fled on a motorcycle. Tiger escaped relatively unhurt, but his driver and a bystander were injured.Earlier sale in the same projectAbout a year ago, Tiger Shroff sold another flat in the same project for Rs 15.6 crore, as per documents reviewed by Square Yards. He made a gain of nearly 31% on the deal.That apartment was on the 22nd floor and had a carpet area of 1,989.72 sq ft and a built-up area of 2,189 sq ft. He had bought it in 2018 for Rs 11.62 crore. It came with three car parking spaces. The buyer paid a stamp duty of Rs 93.60 lakh and registration charges of Rs 30,000.Rustomjee Paramount is spread over 1.65 acres and offers two, three, four and five-bedroom apartments, according to Square Yards.Pune property sold earlier this yearEarlier in 2026, the actor also sold a residential property in Pune’s Hadapsar for Rs 8.87 crore, according to property registration documents accessed by Zapkey. He had bought it in March 2024 for Rs 7.5 crore, which gives a gross return on investment of 18.3%, Zapkey said.The apartment is in the Yoo Pune building by Panchshil Realty and was sold along with three parking spaces. It measures 4,249 sq ft and was sold at Rs 20,891 per sq ft. The deal was registered on March 31, 2026, with a stamp duty of over Rs 62 lakh and a registration fee of Rs 30,000.Tiger Shroff is known for his action roles and dancing skills. The son of veteran actor Jackie Shroff, he made his acting debut in 2014 with ‘Heropanti’.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: In 1999, Sam Neill bought this 12.15-acre estate in New Zealand; following his death, the house was sold off to ‘Aquaman’ star Jason Momoa for NZD 15 million
articles.summary: Hollywood actor Jason Momoa has purchased the former estate of Sam Neill in New Zealand's Central Otago region for NZD 15 million. This expansive property features stunning mountain views and has a rich history, including its past use for government horticultural research.
articles.body: Hollywood star Jason Momoa has officially put down permanent roots in New Zealand’s South Island. According to recent reports, the beloved actor officially acquired Sam Neill’s former Queensland property located in New Zealand following his death. The ownership of the estate had been earlier transferred to his ex-wife, Noriko Watanabe, and now, Momoa has bought out the grand estate. Here’s a look into the iconic home.Jason Momoa buys out Sam Neill’s former New Zealand estateAccording to reports from Realtor.com, the beloved actor bought the ‘Jurassic Park’ actor’s property earlier this year in September. He spent a whopping NZD 15 million on the property, which is overall NZD 3.5 million above the official rating valuation. The estate is situated in the rural enclave of Dalefield, near Queenstown in New Zealand's Central Otago region, a famous area that is known for mountain landscapes and large residential holdings.OneRoof also reported that this transaction marks the second-highest residential sale in the Queenstown-Lakes district in 2026, trailing only behind a luxury lodge on Mooney Road in Speargrass Flat that had earlier sold for NZD 16.5 million.More about Sam Neill’s former Queensland propertySir Sam Neill bought the space in 1999 and owned the property until it was transferred into his ex-wife’s name. The main residential structures on the property were designed by New Zealand architect Richard Naish. Other than that, the main central living house alongside a dedicated "Clubhouse" has been built for hosting and social gatherings there. As for the overall aesthetic of the property, the structures reflect a rural Central Otago alpine aesthetic and have integrated natural elements like timber finishing, stone, and large framed windows designed to capture panoramic views of the surrounding mountains and farm landscape.As for its history, even before the ‘Jurassic Park’ star was bought, the estate had been used for government horticultural research. Remnants of those experimental plantings still remain on the property. Since the space is so vast, it includes organic Pinot Noir and Riesling grapevines as part of the broader Two Paddocks vineyard network, alongside organic vegetable gardens, fruit orchards, and lavender fields used for essential oil production. Neill would often share glimpses of his life on the estate online, which also included his hobby farm, where he named his livestock animals after fellow celebrities, including a Kunekune pig named Bryan Brown, a cow named Helena Bonham Carter, and various sheep and poultry. The actor also planted thousands of native trees and shrubs across the estate. This reforestation brought native bird populations back to the valley, including tūī and bellbirds (korimako).DISCLAIMER: Figures presented in this article are derived from various public sources and are considered approximate unless explicitly noted. articles.title: Quote of the day by Jennifer Aniston: ‘I'm still a romantic. I still believe in love,’ a reminder to never lose faith in love
articles.summary: Jennifer Aniston shares her heartfelt belief in love despite heartbreak, encouraging others to embrace love and healing after relationships. Discover insights on love and moving forward.
articles.body: There's a strange thing about heartbreak. You can spend weeks telling yourself that you're fine, get on with your work, meet your friends and barely think about the person. Then a song comes on, or you walk past a place you used to visit together, and suddenly you're remembering things you thought you'd moved past. Healing doesn't always happen in a straight line, no matter how much you'd like it to.For some people, the hardest part isn't getting over a relationship. It's finding the courage to let someone new into their lives afterwards. The thought of starting again can be exciting, but it can also be frightening when you know how badly things can hurt.Today's quote of the day by Jennifer Aniston is: “I'm still a romantic. I still believe in love.”What does Jennifer Aniston's quote mean?Aniston said this in an interview with Harper's Bazaar Australia. When she was asked if her past relationships had changed the way she felt about love, her answer was clear: she still believed in it.It's easy to say you believe in love when things are going well. But when you break up, you start thinking about what went wrong. Trusting someone new seems like a task, as you are afraid of going through the same pain and betrayal. The ghosts of the past haunt your present and lurk over the future.Sometimes, you become more cautious without even realising it. A new person might seem lovely, but you're already wondering when things will go wrong. You might avoid getting attached because, in your mind, not caring too much means you can't get hurt too badly.The trouble is that protecting yourself from every possible disappointment can also keep you from getting close to anyone. That doesn't mean you should ignore your instincts or trust people before they've earned it. It simply means that one person's actions don't have to become the standard by which you judge everyone else.Why does Jennifer Aniston's message still matter today?People are often quick to tell someone who is heartbroken to move on. They might say there are plenty of other people out there or that the breakup happened for a reason. Sometimes those words help. Other times, you just want someone to understand that you're not ready to stop missing the person yet.There's no fixed schedule for getting over someone. You might feel better after a few weeks, or you might need considerably longer. You can know that ending the relationship was the right decision and still feel sad about it. Those two things aren't mutually exclusive.Then comes the question of dating again. Friends might encourage you to put yourself out there, but only you know when you're ready. There's nothing wrong with enjoying your own company for a while, rediscovering old interests or getting comfortable with life as it is now.Being single doesn't have to be a waiting period before your next relationship. It can just be a part of your life in its own right.At the same time, it's worth remembering that a new relationship won't necessarily repeat the old one. The person will be different, the circumstances will be different, and you'll probably be a little different yourself. You may have a clearer idea of what you need from a partner, which behaviours you're no longer willing to accept and where you need to communicate better.That doesn't mean you should enter a relationship expecting everything to work out. Real relationships are rarely that tidy. People have disagreements, misunderstand each other and occasionally say the wrong thing.Jennifer Aniston's early lifeJennifer Aniston was born on 11 February 1969 in Sherman Oaks, California. Acting was familiar to her from an early age, as her father, John Aniston, also worked in the industry. He became widely known for playing Victor Kiriakis in the television soap opera 'Days of Our Lives'.Aniston attended Fiorello H. LaGuardia High School of Music & Art and Performing Arts in New York City, where she studied acting. But having an interest in the profession and a parent who understood the industry didn't mean her own career would automatically take off.She spent her early years taking smaller roles and looking for opportunities. The success most people associate with her name was still ahead of her.How did Jennifer Aniston rise to fame?In 1994, Jennifer Aniston landed one of the most iconic roles of her career. She played Rachel Green in 'Friends,' the sitcom which became a major success, and her character soon became one of television's most recognisable personalities. Viewers followed her friendships, romances and career struggles, while her hairstyle became a trend of its own.The role changed Aniston's career, but she didn't stop working in television and film once the sitcom ended in 2004. She appeared in movies such as 'Bruce Almighty', 'The Break-Up' and 'Marley & Me'. Later, she returned to television with 'The Morning Show'. It also starred Reese Witherspoon.Her personal life has also attracted plenty of public attention, particularly her relationships. Celebrities may have millions of people following their lives, but when a relationship ends, they go through many of the same feelings as everyone else.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Aaradhya Bachchan looks taller than Aishwarya Rai Bachchan, flaunts long locks in new family photos as Shrima Rai shares glimpses of nephew Shivansh’s birthday celebration
articles.summary: Aaradhya Bachchan caught everyone’s attention in new family pictures shared by Shrima Rai, Aishwarya Rai Bachchan’s sister-in-law, from nephew Shivansh
articles.body: Aaradhya Bachchan caught everyone’s attention in new family pictures shared by Shrima Rai, Aishwarya Rai Bachchan’s sister-in-law, from nephew Shivansh Rai’s birthday celebration. The 14-year-old appeared taller than her mother, Aishwarya, in the photographs, while her long locks also reminded fans of the actress’s signature hairstyle.The birthday celebration brought Aishwarya, Aaradhya and other members of the Rai family together for an intimate gathering. Shrima shared glimpses of the occasion on Instagram, offering fans a peek into the family’s special moments.Aaradhya Bachchan’s height and long hair grab attentionIn the pictures, Aaradhya is seen wearing a denim shirt and jeans, keeping her look simple and casual. Her height became a talking point, with some social media users noticing that she appeared taller than Aishwarya.One fan commented, “How is Aishwarya's daughter looking taller than her?” Another wrote, “Beautiful family.”Aaradhya’s long hair also caught attention, with her locks appearing nearly as long as her mother’s. The mother-daughter duo’s similar casual styling added to the interest surrounding the pictures.Aishwarya Rai celebrates nephew Shivansh’s birthday with familyThe photographs showed Aishwarya posing with her brother, Aditya Rai, sister-in-law Shrima, mother Vrinda Rai, Aaradhya and other family members. In one picture, the family gathered around Shivansh as he cut his birthday cake. Another photograph showed Shrima feeding a piece of cake to the birthday boy.Aishwarya opted for a blue shirt, denim jeans and sunglasses, while Aaradhya sported a denim shirt and jeans. The pictures also featured Aaradhya posing with her cousins.Sharing the photographs, Shrima wrote, “Happy Birthday to my cutie pie @shivansh_rai23. Here’s to more pranks, more time with nature, more laughter and blessings. So proud of you!”The pictures also offered a glimpse of the family’s photo wall, which featured framed photographs of Aishwarya’s parents, family members and younger generations.Shrima Rai’s past social media controversyShrima had previously attracted attention on social media amid speculation surrounding Aishwarya and Abhishek Bachchan’s marriage.In November 2024, she made headlines after sharing a photograph of flowers sent to her by Shweta Bachchan Nanda and her husband, Nikhil Nanda, on her birthday. The gesture drew online attention amid rumours about Aishwarya and Abhishek’s relationship.Shrima clarified that her birthday was on November 21 and described the flowers as a customary birthday gesture.She also addressed comments questioning her professional identity in relation to Aishwarya, stating that she had built her career as a content creator independently and had never tried to start a business using anyone else’s name.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more.
